course.tagline: A multi-asset community covering crypto, stocks, prediction markets and sports betting, with five expert-led sections.
course.about: Wealth Group is a trading and investing community founded by Johnny ("cryptogodjohn"). Members get live calls, market insights and educational content across five Discord sections, each led by a different analyst (JD, Pocky, DB, Tareeq and Impulse). Worth knowing up front: alongside crypto, stocks and prediction markets, the community also covers sports betting — it isn't exclusively a trading education product.

_notes.source: Founder (Johnny, "cryptogodjohn") and pricing confirmed via Whop's own product page and whoptrends.com (which also confirmed a 30% affiliate commission). No separate official website found outside Whop. No Trustpilot profile found (wealthgroup.io 404s). Two affiliate links given — card payment and crypto payment — for what appears to be the same underlying plans; crypto payment link only confirmed for the monthly tier. Scope note: this community explicitly includes sports betting alongside crypto/stocks/prediction markets, stated plainly in our own 'about' copy rather than glossed over.
